30 min–2 hours per difficulty (max. 10 min per fight)

In the {wiki:Svargrond Arena|Svargrond arena} you face 10 fighters in a row on your own, in three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. Pay the fee to {npc:Halvar}, win the 10 fights of each level and choose one of five rewards (three weapons, a gift or a backpack), plus a bronze, silver or gold goblet with your name. Finishing Warlord gives the achievement **Warlord of Svargrond**.
Having completed the previous difficulties (Greenhorn before Scrapper, Scrapper before Warlord).
Entry fee: 1,000 gp (Greenhorn), 5,000 gp (Scrapper) or 10,000 gp (Warlord).
All the supplies (potions, runes) you will need for the 10 fights: there is no way to restock in there
optional, useful for low-level characters on Greenhorn
For each difficulty, choose **one** of 5 rewards: three weapons, a present or a backpack of ammo/runes
Bring extra supplies: there is no way to restock during the 10 fights.
Each fight has a **10-minute** limit. If you take longer, you fail and are kicked out.
If you die in the arena you **do not recover your items**: your corpse is deleted if another player enters the arena to fetch them.
Other players can see you from above, but an invisible barrier prevents passing items in or out of the arena.

Go to **Svargrond**: take the boat from **Carlin**, **Thais** or **Venore** (tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}). You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city. The arena is in the **north** of the city, inside Svargrond.

To leave the arena in the middle of a difficulty, use the teleport to the **south** of the room you are in: you are sent outside, but count as defeated. To go home, take Captain Breezelda's boat and say the name of the city (for example {key:carlin}, {key:thais} or {key:venore}) and {key:yes}.

Go to the arena in the **north** of {wiki:Svargrond|Svargrond} and talk to {npc:Halvar}. Pay the fee for the difficulty you want to do: **1,000 gp** (Greenhorn), **5,000 gp** (Scrapper) or **10,000 gp** (Warlord). You can only choose a difficulty if you have completed the previous ones.

After paying, go through the {item:Door (Sealed)|sealed door} next to Halvar. At the end of the path there are 3 {item:Magic Forcefield|Magic Forcefields}: any of them takes you to the first arena, and the first fighter appears **as soon as you arrive**.
Only one person at a time can be in each arena room.

Each difficulty has **10 fights**, always in the same 10 rooms (Greenhorn 1 is the same room as Scrapper 1). When you kill the fighter, the blue stone to the **west** of the room turns into a teleport to the next room.
The teleport to the **south** of each room is for giving up: if you step into it, you admit defeat and are sent out. Each fight has a 10-minute limit.

You shouldn't have trouble until the 9th fighter. The two dangerous ones are the {creature:Cursed Gladiator} (similar to a {creature:Crypt Shambler}) and {creature:Orcus the Cruel} (similar to an {creature:Orc Leader}).
Low-level characters can use {item:Closed Trap|Traps} to deal extra damage, because the fighters have little armour.
You receive a {item:Bronze Goblet} with the inscription *"Awarded to (your name)."* and choose **one** of these rewards:
Bronze Goblet + reward of your choice
Recommended level 50 (no mandatory level). You must have completed Greenhorn.
You receive a {item:Silver Goblet} with the inscription *"Awarded to (your name)."* and choose **one** of these rewards:
Silver Goblet + reward of your choice
Recommended level 120. You must have completed Scrapper.

For reference, a level 110 {wiki:Elite Knight|Elite Knight} typically uses about **260** {item:Mana Potion|Mana Potions} and **125** {item:Great Health Potion|Great Health Potions} on this difficulty. Take everything with you: there is no way to restock.
You receive a {item:Golden Goblet} with the inscription *"Awarded to (your name)."*, the achievement **Warlord of Svargrond** and choose **one** of these rewards:
Golden Goblet + reward of your choice + Warlord of Svargrond achievement
Progress appears in the Quest Log as *The Ultimate Challenges*.
All three difficulties use the same 10 arena rooms.
